exercisePlan.note: NASA: six to seven days a week, ISS astronauts do resistance and aerobic exercise for 1.5 hours per day. Used as the mission plan target, not a medical threshold.

adaptationDays.note: Dr. Brian Crucian (NASA immunology): an early adaptation phase of about 45 days, then a "space normal" state. Personal baselines formed in this phase are marked as still settling.
